title: StateManager (APVTS XML save/restore, layout version, A/B slots) and PluginEditor skeleton
description:
Add StateManager and a minimal PluginEditor skeleton. Depends on a.2 ParameterIDs / processor types.

Before editing, inspect:
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredeq/Source/StateManager.h and StateManager.cpp (A/B slots, schema_version, capture/apply patterns — simplify; do not copy gain-match machinery unless tiny)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp from a.2 (APVTS accessors, get/setStateInformation hooks)
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredeq/Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp for Timer + editor construction pattern
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §5 (parameterLayoutVersion) and §13

Implement:
1. Source/StateManager.h/.cpp:
   - Owns schema-versioned state helpers for ShredWidth.
   - Full APVTS XML serialization helpers used by getStateInformation/setStateInformation: copyState → ValueTree with parameterLayoutVersion (or schema_version) property; restore replaces APVTS state; reject/ignore newer future versions safely; allow forward migration hook stub when version < current.
   - A/B slots: captureSlot/applySlot (or captureFrom/applyTo + swap/copy A↔B) storing ValueTree snapshots; active slot tracking.
   - Message-thread only for XML/ValueTree; document RT-unsafe.

2. Wire PluginProcessor getStateInformation/setStateInformation to StateManager (edit only the state methods and private StateManager member in PluginProcessor if required — keep changes minimal and do not rework APVTS layout or bus/PDC logic from a.2).

3. Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp skeleton:
   - ShredWidthAudioProcessorEditor : juce::AudioProcessorEditor, juce::Timer
   - Constructor takes processor ref; setSize reasonable default (e.g. 800×480); add juce::ResizableCornerComponent and setResizable with limits; Timer start at 30–60 Hz with empty/lightweight timerCallback.
   - paint/resized stubs (dark background fill, no full control layout yet).
   - Processor createEditor returns new ShredWidthAudioProcessorEditor(*this); hasEditor true.

Do not implement Goniometer, CorrelationMeter, CustomLookAndFeel, or full rotary layout (phase D). Do not edit CMakeLists.txt unless absolutely unavoidable; a.1 already lists editor/processor sources.
acceptance_criteria: Source/StateManager.h and Source/StateManager.cpp exist with A/B slot capture/apply and parameterLayoutVersion (or schema_version) on saved state
PluginProcessor getStateInformation/setStateInformation round-trip APVTS via StateManager XML/ValueTree path
Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp define ShredWidthAudioProcessorEditor with Timer and ResizableCornerComponent
createEditor returns ShredWidthAudioProcessorEditor and hasEditor is true
StateManager does not allocate or lock on a documented audio-thread API path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: rename or renumber ParameterIDs stable strings
implement full GUI controls, LookAndFeel, goniometer, or correlation meter

allowed: simplify ShredEQ StateManager A/B pattern without gain-match meters
minimal processor edits to own StateManager and delegate state I/O
forbidden: change bus layout or parameter inventory
